title: Test Repair Policy

core_principles.CLASSIFICATION_FIRST: Classify each test failure BEFORE attempting repair: ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH, CODE_BUG, DATA_ISSUE, CONFIG_ISSUE, TEST_BUG
core_principles.HONEST_SKIP_ALLOWED: Tests that cannot pass due to environment mismatch (wrong Django version, missing services) may be skipped with documented reason
core_principles.NO_FAKE_PASS: Never modify test assertions to force-pass; never hide skipped tests in counts; never claim skip==pass

classification_categories.example: Django 6.x removed features used in test (REALWORLD-2: 2 skips)

classification_categories.action: FIX in app code OR REPORT (do not fix test to hide bug)
FIX test data or database state
classification_categories.example: Missing fixture data, stale test DB

classification_categories.action: FIX the test (wrong field name, wrong assertion)
classification_categories.example: Form field name mismatch with model (REALWORLD-2: most fixes)

reporting_rules: Always report as 'X pass / Y skip / Z fail' — never collapse skips into pass
Verifier must check: skip_count > 0 AND (pass + skip + fail) == total_tests
Skip-hiding is a verifier FAIL condition

realworld2_evidence.test_file_changes: 1 test file (test_forms.py) — field name alignment only
